# BSC (Bharat Steel Group) — Sales Call Knowledge Base (auto-distilled)

## Corpus summary

This corpus contains several hundred call snippets, but the number of **genuine sales/rate-negotiation calls is modest** — maybe 60-70 calls have real commercial content (rate quoting, quantity/order talk, stock availability, objection handling). The rest is internal logistics chatter (driver/location updates, MTC/tag paperwork follow-ups, loading/crane coordination), voicemail stubs, wrong numbers, and a large volume of unrelated personal/Hindi conversations (Vishal's calls) that have **no sales content** and were excluded from analysis.

The real sales calls are almost all **B2B dealer/fabricator/contractor enquiries** for structural steel and plate products, handled mostly by women sales executives (Varsha, Divya, and others) fielding rate requests from site engineers, fabricators, and traders across Chennai and neighboring states (Andhra, Odisha). Conversations are short, transactional, and repeat a narrow set of patterns: rate check → quantity confirm → small discount push → stock/brand availability → payment/dispatch logistics. There is very little classic "consultative selling" — most calls are quick order-processing exchanges with occasional price objection handling.

## Products & brand ladder

Based only on what is actually discussed in calls:

- **TMT Rebar** — grades FE500, 500D, 550D. Reps repeatedly clarify: *"500 stop பண்ணிட்டாங்களா... 500 வந்து வெறும் R&L தான் sir produce பண்ணுவாங்க"* [500 grade is only made by R&L/RINL now; others don't produce it]. "Sale" (trade) TMT in CRS typically comes only as 500D, not 550D.
- **MS Plates** — thickness range 2mm–45mm, in standard sizes (2500×1250, 6300mm length coils-cut, etc.). Brands cited: **Vizag (RINL)**, **SAIL**, **NMDC**, **Vaisakh**. Checkered plate also mentioned.
- **Structural steel** — ISMB (I-beam), ISMC/Channel, Angle (L angle), Flat (various cross-sections like 300×140, 300×150, 50×5, 100×6), MS Round.
- **HR Coil/Sheet, CR Coil Sheet** — CR cold-rolled sheet (e.g., 0.6mm IS 513 grade), coil-cut-to-size sheets.
- **Pipes** — CHS pipe, Square pipe, Rectangular pipe, SHS (square hollow section) — reps are clear BSC does **not** deal in these directly: *"நம்ம deal பண்றது இல்ல Ma'am"* [We don't deal in that].
- **Build-up/PEB sections** — explicitly declined as a standard product: *"அது உங்க fabricator தான் sir நீங்க கேக்கணும்"* [That's your fabricator's job to spec, not ours].

**Brand ladder logic used by reps:**
- Vizag/RINL and SAIL are treated as **premium/benchmark** brands, often quoted at similar price points.
- Tata Steel is positioned as a **premium alternative with higher rate** but reliable stock — *"Tata rate அந்த rate தான் வரும்"* [Tata will always command that higher price].
- "Local/conversion" material (unbranded rolling) is the **cheaper fallback** when main-brand stock is short, explicitly flagged as lower-grade: *"இதெல்லாம் rolling தான் சார் வரும்... sale wise-ஆ produce பண்ண மாட்டாங்க local தான்"* [This is just rolled/converted stock, not produced for formal sale].
- Apollo brand is cited specifically for certain pipe/flat items.

## Real rates & terms (only rates that actually appear in the calls)

Prices fluctuate daily/weekly across the corpus (steel market volatility is a constant theme) — reps repeatedly say *"rate increase ஆயிடுச்சு"* [rate has gone up]. Sample real figures seen:

- HR Plate: **₹66 + tax**, customer negotiated to **₹68** inclusive (fabricator/trader call) — thickness 10–12mm; beyond that "₹1000-2000 extra."
- ISMB / Channel / Angle: **₹65–67/kg** range repeatedly quoted as "the same range."
- MS Round: **₹65–70/kg**.
- Structural steel (plate+ISMB combined quote): **65+ range**, e.g., "66+tax ... 8,10-ல கொஞ்சம் ஜாஸ்தி".
- 8mm steel sheet (1500mm): **₹595/kg → ₹59,500 total**, compared against Tata's ₹60/kg.
- TMT 12mm: **₹69 + GST**; TMT 16mm: **₹68.5 + GST** (quoted, "16mm வந்து 500 கிடைக்கும்" = ₹500 cheaper than 12mm).
- Flat 5.5m length: opening quote **₹54**, negotiated down to final **₹53.50 ("535 final")** + GST + loading + transport extra.
- Sheet rate example: **₹65.50/kg**, previously ₹58–59 a month earlier — a **₹1500 increase in one month**.
- CRS 20mm "sale" grade: **₹69,000** (per ton-level quote), confirmed as the only size in stock.
- Vizag structural rate: **₹65,000** for 16–25mm; 12mm ~₹500 extra; 10mm ~₹2500 extra; 8mm ~₹3500 extra (size-wise step-up pricing).
- Plate rate for a contractor: **₹64/kg**, asked to reduce by ₹500 to **₹63.50**.
- TMT (Zetwork): initial quote revised down by **₹500** to **₹63.50/kg**, loading extra.
- Steel sheet quote to a transport/earthmover customer: **₹70/kg + tax**, admin noted margin add of "₹1" buffer internally between branches.

**Standard commercial terms repeatedly confirmed across calls:**
- All rates are **+ GST, + loading charges, + transport charges extra** — this is stated almost every time: *"basic rate... + GST + loading transport எல்லாமே extra"*.
- **Full payment before dispatch** is the default for non-PO customers: *"mail confirmation is mandatory... நீங்க PO குடுக்குறது இல்லல்ல"* [since you don't issue a PO, email confirmation is mandatory].
- Credit terms exist but are limited — one customer mentioned 1-month credit vs advance payment affecting price: *"Credit-ல போயிடுச்சா... 1 month தான்"*.
- Rate validity is short — *"validity 2 days அப்படின்னு சொல்லிருக்காங்க சார்"* [Validity is only 2 days].
